items.source: Return an SslBundle with the provided name.
items.translation: 返回一个名为指定名称的SslBundle。

items.source: Add a handler that will be called each time the named bundle is updated.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，每当命名 bundle 更新时都会调用它。

items.source: Return the names of all bundles managed by this instance.
items.translation: 返回此实例管理的所有 bundle 的名称。

items.source: NoSuchSslBundleException - if a bundle with the provided name does not exist
items.translation: NoSuchSslBundleException - 如果提供的名称对应的包不存在

items.source: Scott Frederick, Moritz Halbritter, Jonatan Ivanov
A managed set of SslBundle instances that can be retrieved by name.
items.translation: 一个由名称检索的已管理的SslBundle实例集。

items.source: Add a handler that will be called each time a bundle is registered.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，每当注册一个 bundle 时都会调用它。

items.source:
Add a handler that will be called each time a bundle is registered. The handler
will be called with the bundle name and the bundle.
items.translation: 添加一个处理器，每当注册一个 bundle 时就会被调用。该处理器将接收 bundle 名称和 bundle 作为参数。
